propositions: _build_jira_backend constructs AcliClient without validating presence of JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, and JIRA_API_TOKEN, allowing silent construction with empty credentials that fail later at first API call

Missing or whitespace-only credentials should be detected at backend construction time and raise BackendEnvError naming each missing variable and describing the anonymous-access consequence, matching DC's established pattern
JIRA_USER must be validated as an email format (containing @ with non-empty local and domain parts) at construction time to reject invalid bare handles that would silently 401 at runtime

Test test_cloud_build_backend_with_missing_credentials_does_not_fail_loudly currently documents and pins the absence of credential validation and must be flipped to assert the new loud failure behavior

test_the_cloud_factory_also_asserts_conformance uses invalid non-email credentials to exercise conformance checking but must be updated to use valid email credentials so the credential guard passes before conformance is tested
